wholeProduct.summary: TradeScout county discovery, claims-first accounts, gated requests/contact, business profiles and remaining isolated recovery work.

deliverables.outcome: Combine already-authorized recovery and action-first onboarding into one verified local integration candidate.
deliverables.entry: A guest begins a business recommendation, creates a minimal account, and returns to save it.
deliverables.ending: The recommendation remains private until verified and moderated; existing recovery request/contact and legacy privacy contracts remain correct.

proof.procedure: Run immutable migration checks, native recommendation and recovery proofs, focused UI/security tests, typecheck/build, and exact-commit minimum release gate with current synthetic browser journeys.
proof.expected: Immutable main history; restoration before projection; private unclassified legacy data; actor-verified and moderated publication; preserved recovery authority.
proof.observed: Combined native recommendation, legacy/schema, recovery and suppression proofs passed. Independent review reproduced and repaired CVS moderation-case inflation and disabled-author replay status; both regressions failed before and passed after the bounded fixes. The strict minimum release gate and actual desktop/mobile journeys passed the earlier combined checkpoint; current exact-source receipts are recorded separately after the corrected candidate is committed.

journeySteps: Recover and restore the immutable migration chain.
Save the recommendation through canonical account and recommendation owners.
Verify both new publication safeguards and existing recovery denial cases.
constraints: Use existing TradeScout repository and canonical permission/storage/component owners; preserve County Map WIP and separate JW product changes.

completionClaims.claim: Only the local integration candidate is closed after current combined evidence. Merge, deployment, real-provider proof and broader unfinished work remain separate.

excludedFromActive: LSS saved-content release is the next dependent deliverable; JW presentation, County Map and other product stacks retain separate ownership.

deliverables.outcome: Root-owned integration review, draft PR and any explicitly authorized future release; Infinity refresh and Exchange connection keep separate owners.
Preserve remaining JW, County Map, membership, dependency and external-provider work for its own evidence-backed completion.

executionTarget.rationale: Existing TradeScout React/Express/Postgres contracts and Render production path own the workflow.
constraintsConsidered: Persistent requests and identity, explicit access decisions, append-only migrations and existing production repository.
